# Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3

Pinned local distribution from https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/.
Upstream documentation: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster.
MIT license included in `LICENSE`. Custom icons use the base `MarkerCluster.css`, not the optional default icon theme.

Used only by the admin libraries map; map tiles and Leaflet itself retain the existing providers.
